sections.shortTitle: North-West Frontier Province Sales Tax Amendment Act 2009
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT VII OF 2009
ACT VII OF 2009
NORTH-WEST
FRONTIER PROVINCE
SALES
TAX (AMENDMENT) ACT,
2009
An Act to amend the North-West Frontier Province
Sales Tax Ordinance,
2000
[Gazette of N.-W.F.P.
Extraordinary,
19th March, 2009]
No.PA/NWFP/Bills/2009/10855, dated
19-3-2009.---The North-West Fronteir
Province Sales Tax (Amendment) Bill, 2009 having been passed by the Provincial
Assembly of North-West Frontier Province on 11th March, 2009 and assented to by
the Governor of the North-West Frontier Province on 12th March, 2009 is hereby
published as an Act of the Provincial Legislature of the North-West Frontier
Province.
Whereas it is expedient to amend the
North-West Frontier Province Sales Tax Ordinance, 2000 (N.-W.F.P. Ord. No.III of 2000), for the
purpose hereinafter appearing;
It is hereby enacted as follows:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Act
may be called the North-West Frontier Province Sales Tax (Amendment) Act, 2009.
(2) It shall come into force at once and
shall be deemed to have taken effect from 1st July, 2008.
